start.title: La Plaine de Shinar
start.text:
Une vaste plaine verte s'étend devant toi.
Toute l'humanité s'est rassemblée ici — un seul peuple, une seule langue.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Settle and build a home
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You sink roots into the earth. It feels right.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Dream of something greater
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The horizon is not enough. You want the sky.

unity.title: Une Seule Langue
unity.text:
Les voix se mêlent. Les rires s'élèvent.
Il n'y a pas un mot que tu ne puisses comprendre.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Praise God for the gift of unity
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You lift your voice in thanks. Others bow their heads.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Boast of what we could achieve
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Pride sparks in the crowd. Eyes turn upward.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Stay silent — listen to the elders
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Wise voices speak softly. Others shout louder.

proposal.title: La Grande Idée
proposal.text:
Un ancien se lève. « Bâtissons une tour — dont le sommet atteindra les cieux. »
« Faisons-nous un nom. »

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Cheer — join the great work
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your voice is one of thousands. The crowd roars.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Speak against it — this is pride
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Few hear you. But the words are spoken.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Wait — let others decide
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Silence is its own answer. The vote passes.

bricks.title: Briques et Goudron
bricks.text:
Tu moules l'argile humide en briques.
Elles sont plus solides que la pierre. Elles atteindront le ciel.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Work for the love of craft
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your hands move with care. The work itself is good.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Race the others — outshine them
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your speed turns to recklessness. Bricks crack.

construction.title: Les Premiers Étages
construction.text:
Les murs s'élèvent. La tour projette une longue ombre.
Les hommes chantent en soulevant chaque poutre.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Boast — "We need no God now"
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Workers cheer. Above, the silence deepens.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Work quietly — say a prayer
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] No one hears. But the prayer is heard above.

rising.title: Plus Haut
rising.text:
Année après année. Pierre après pierre.
La tour transperce les nuages.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Doubt — should we stop?
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You whisper it. The wind carries the words away.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Climb higher — there is no limit
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The ladder feels endless. Your pride is fuel.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Demand the workers go faster
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Tempers fray. Hands bleed. The tower climbs.

summit.title: Toucher le Ciel
summit.text:
Tu te tiens au sommet. La terre est petite en bas.
Les cieux semblent proches — presque à portée de main.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Reach upward — claim the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your fingers find only wind. Yet you feel watched.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Kneel — feel suddenly small
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The vastness above swallows your pride.

gods_gaze.title: Il descend
gods_gaze.text:
Une voix emplit l'air, calme comme le tonnerre.
« Ils sont un seul peuple. Rien ne leur sera impossible. »

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Stand defiant before the voice
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your courage withers. The air grows heavy.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Bow your head in fear and awe
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your knees buckle. The presence is everywhere.

confusion.title: Étranges paroles
confusion.text:
Tu cries à ton ami. Il te fixe du regard.
Sa bouche s'ouvre — mais les sons n'ont aucun sens.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Force him to understand — shout louder
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Anger only deepens the void between you.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Step back — accept what God has done
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Tears fall. The wall between you is unbreakable.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Blame the elders — start a fight
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Fists fly. The tower bleeds men instead of mortar.

scattering.title: Partir
scattering.text:
Les familles rassemblent ce qu'elles peuvent.
Chaque groupe marche vers un horizon différent.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Curse the heavens as you leave
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Bitterness is a heavy load to carry.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Walk in silence, lesson in heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Each step is a small confession.

reflection.title: Une nouvelle terre
reflection.text:
Tu t'arrêtes sur une crête tranquille.
La tour est loin derrière — un souvenir de fierté.
